Tasks.Title: Play and sign off "Lava Forest Obby" (r1)
Tasks.Detail:
"Lava Forest Obby" passed its tests on revision r1: map 92/100, engine: 3 checks passed; the server booted with no errors., review: Passed: clean build r1, every engine check green, map 92/100, 0 warning(s)..
Play it before it is marketed: ▶ Play on the game's page (Play in Roblox, or Open in Studio). Look at the World tab's renders and the map report.
Then Approve the build, or Request changes with what to fix (it goes to the builder as a direction and the game goes back to Build). Nothing is published or created on Roblox until the launch approval that follows.

Tasks.Title: Approve the launch of "Lava Forest Obby"
Tasks.Detail:
Ready to go public as "Lava Forest Obby" in experience 1001 (revision r1, run clean in Roblox's engine).
Store page:
Don't touch the lava! Leap across glowing platforms through a pine forest, save at every checkpoint and race to the golden finish. New stages are coming soon.

Products:
- Skip Stage (product, R$ 25): Skips the stage you are on
- VIP (game pass, R$ 149): Earn double coins forever

Approve to let the studio create the products, set the store page and thumbnails, publish and make the game public. Request changes to send it back (say what to change).
Maturity questionnaire answers prepared:
- Violence: none.
- Blood and gore: none.
- Fear: none.
- Crude humour, romance, alcohol, gambling, strong language: none.
- Social features: standard Roblox chat only; no free-text player content from the game.
- Monetization: Skip Stage (DeveloperProduct, 25 R$), VIP (GamePass, 149 R$); no paid random items.
